subject: Post-discovery: schedule tech deep-dive & evaluation kickoff
messages:
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@medalytics.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule tech deep-dive & evaluation kickoff

Hi Liam / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + next steps so we can get the evaluation moving: 

Recap (from our notes)
- Primary goal: reduce false positives in your triage classifier and cut average triage time by ~30%.
- Data scope: anonymized ticket text + metadata (priority, customer tier) for 3 months (10k tickets).
- Security: SOC2 in place; you requested audit log retention and VPC deployment options.

Proposal / next steps
1) Technical deep-dive (30–45m) — walk through model choices, prompt set considerations, and sample inference latencies for your expected p95 length. Recommend SE-led session.
2) Evaluation kickoff (60m) — finalize success criteria, agree on prompt-set + metrics, and calendar the trial run (2 weeks).
3) Mutual action plan (MAP) — responsibilities, data handoff window, and measurement cadence. Draft MAP attached (MedaLytics-MAP-v1.xlsx).

Proposed windows (PST) — pick one that works and I will send invites: 
- Mon 23 Nov, 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–12:00 or 15:30–16:30
- Wed 25 Nov, 08:30–09:30 (earlier slot if you prefer)

Asks from your side before kickoff
- Confirm which slot you prefer.
- Share a representative sample of anonymized tickets (CSV) and any label schema.
- Draft success criteria (we suggested precision@K and mean time to triage) — we attached a sample prompt set to get started: proposed-prompt-set.csv.

I copied Aditya (SE) and Neha (CS) so they can join the deep-dive and help scope the MAP. If any of the times above don't work, here's a direct booking link: https://calendly.com/redwood-vanessa/tech-deep-dive-30m

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: medalytics-discovery-notes.pdf, proposed-prompt-set.csv, MedaLytics-MAP-v1.xlsx
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medalytics.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medalytics.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule tech deep-dive & evaluation kickoff

Vanessa — appreciate the clear recap. Priya and I chatted and the Tue 24 Nov 15:30–16:30 PST slot works best for us.

A couple of clarifications on success criteria so the SE session can be focused: 
- We want to measure reduction in false positive rate for P1/P2 incidents and track precision@10 for suggested labels.
- Baseline: current precision@10 = 0.62; target to achieve in the trial is >= 0.75.
- Latency: we need p95 under 350ms for payloads up to 600 tokens (including any post-processing).

We will share a 2k-ticket anonymized CSV and the label mapping by EOD Thursday. Can Aditya confirm who should receive the dataset (S3 bucket vs secure upload)?

Thanks — Liam

Liam — thanks, 24 Nov 15:30 PST is on our side and I've tentatively blocked 45m for a technical deep-dive followed by a separate 60m slot for the evaluation kickoff the next day (we can collapse if you prefer).

For data transfer: preferred path is S3 presigned upload. I'll send an upload bucket + IAM instructions to Priya and cc Vanessa by EOD Thursday. If you require a secure upload link instead, let me know and we can arrange an encrypted transfer.

Agenda for the 24 Nov deep-dive (high level)
- 5m: quick introductions and goals
- 20m: model candidate choices and latency/throughput implications
- 15m: prompt set review and sample inference with your representative ticket
- 5m: confirm success criteria and next steps for the 60m kickoff (data handoff, metrics dashboard, and acceptance test)

I've attached a short checklist (medalytics-discovery-notes.pdf) with items we'll need for the kickoff.

-Aditya
